entries.definition_vi: kết bạn với người khác
examples: I made friends with several classmates during my first week at university.
It can take time to make friends after moving to a new city.

entries.definition_vi: mất liên lạc với một người
examples: I lost touch with my school friends when I moved abroad.
People sometimes lose touch when their routines change.
collocations: lose touch with an old friend

entries.definition_vi: gặp hoặc trò chuyện để cập nhật tình hình với bạn bè
entries.pattern: catch up with a friend + over + food/drink
examples: I caught up with a friend over coffee last weekend.
She calls every month to catch up with a friend from school.
collocations: catch up with an old friend

entries.definition_vi: hẹn gặp bạn bè để cùng làm gì đó
entries.pattern: meet up with friends + at/in + place
examples: I meet up with friends at the park on Saturday afternoons.
We met up with friends after the concert.

entries.definition_vi: dần hiểu và quen biết một người
entries.pattern: get to know someone + through + activity
examples: I got to know my neighbour through our shared garden.
Group projects help students get to know someone outside their usual circle.

entries.definition_vi: có nhiều sở thích hoặc đặc điểm giống nhau
entries.pattern: have a lot in common + with + person
examples: I have a lot in common with my best friend, especially our taste in music.
They discovered they had a lot in common during the trip.
collocations: have a lot in common with a friend

entries.definition_vi: cùng quan tâm đến một sở thích hoặc lĩnh vực
examples: We share an interest in photography and often visit exhibitions together.
They became friends because they shared an interest in cycling.

entries.definition_vi: ở bên và hỗ trợ ai đó khi họ cần
entries.pattern: be there for someone + during + difficult time
examples: My friend was there for me when I lost my job.
Being there for someone can mean simply listening to them.
collocations: always be there for a friend

entries.definition_vi: giúp một tay trong một công việc
examples: I lent a hand with the decorations for her birthday party.
Could you lend a hand with these heavy boxes?

entries.definition_vi: đề nghị giúp đỡ hoặc động viên người khác
examples: Our neighbours offered support when my family moved house.
She offered support to a friend who was preparing for an exam.

entries.definition_vi: xin lời khuyên về một vấn đề
entries.pattern: ask + person + for advice + about/on + issue
examples: I asked my friend for advice about choosing a course.
She asks for advice when she faces an unfamiliar problem.

entries.definition_vi: đưa ra lời khuyên chân thành và thẳng thắn
examples: I try to give honest advice without sounding unkind.
He gave honest advice to his friend about the interview.

entries.definition_vi: xây dựng sự tin tưởng qua thời gian
examples: Keeping small promises can build trust between friends.
They built trust by working together on a difficult project.

entries.definition_vi: làm mất lòng tin của một người
examples: Sharing her private message would break her trust.
He broke his friend's trust by repeating a secret.

entries.definition_vi: giữ đúng lời hứa đã đưa ra
examples: I kept a promise to visit my friend after her surgery.
Children notice when adults keep a promise.

entries.definition_vi: làm ai đó thất vọng vì không đáp ứng điều họ trông đợi
examples: I did not want to let my friend down by cancelling at the last minute.
She felt she had let him down when she forgot the appointment.

entries.definition_vi: làm hòa sau khi cãi nhau
entries.pattern: make up after an argument + with + person
examples: We made up after an argument about our travel plans.
She wanted to make up after an argument instead of avoiding her friend.
collocations: make up after a minor argument

entries.definition_vi: giải quyết một bất đồng giữa các bên
entries.pattern: sort out a disagreement + with + person
examples: We sorted out a disagreement by talking calmly.
They need to sort out a disagreement before planning the event.

entries.definition_vi: bất hòa và không còn thân thiện với một người bạn
entries.pattern: fall out with a friend + over + issue
examples: I fell out with a friend over a misunderstanding, but we later talked.
She does not want to fall out with a friend over a small mistake.
collocations: fall out with a close friend

entries.definition_vi: xin lỗi vì một lỗi mình đã mắc
entries.pattern: apologise to + person + for a mistake
examples: I apologised for a mistake that delayed our group project.
He chose to apologise for a mistake instead of blaming someone else.

entries.definition_vi: tha thứ cho một người sau khi họ làm mình tổn thương
examples: I forgave my friend for forgetting my birthday.
It took her time to forgive someone who had broken her trust.

entries.definition_vi: duy trì sự thân thiết với một người bạn
entries.pattern: stay close to a friend + despite + change
examples: I stayed close to a friend even after we moved to different cities.
Regular calls help me stay close to a friend from childhood.
collocations: stay close to an old friend

entries.definition_vi: dần xa cách nhau theo thời gian
examples: We drifted apart after leaving school, although we never argued.
Friends may drift apart when they live far from each other.

entries.definition_vi: giới thiệu một người với bạn của mình
examples: I introduced my neighbour to a friend at the party.
She introduced her colleague to a friend who works in the same field.
collocations: introduce a colleague to a friend

entries.definition_vi: mời ai đó đến nhà mình chơi
examples: I invited my classmates over for dinner on Friday.
She often invites friends over to watch a film.
collocations: invite a friend over for dinner
